> import sys
> import os
> hex_file = 'data.hex'
> bin_file = 'binary.bin'
> with open(hex_file, 'r') as f:
>     lines = f.readlines()
> bytes_data = b''
> for line in lines:
>     line = line.strip()
>     if not line:
>         continue
>     # each line is two hex characters
>     for i in range(0, len(line), 2):
>         byte_str = line[i:i+2]
>         byte_val = int(byte_str, 16)
>         bytes_data += bytes([byte_val])
> with open(bin_file, 'wb') as f:
>     f.write(bytes_data)
> print('Binary file written')
> EOF
